headnotes.text: Under the burden-shifting framework for Title VII and ADEA pretext claims, once the employer articulates legitimate nondiscriminatory reasons, the plaintiff must cast sufficient doubt on each reason that a factfinder could find it fabricated, or show discrimination was more likely than not a motivating or determinative cause.
